name: Track the Human Optic TRAct (THOTRA) - Trekker
summary: Tracks the human optic tract from the optic chiasm to the LGN with Trekker parallel transport tractography on CSD FODs, and outputs a tractogram and a white matter classification.
description: Seeds Trekker in the optic chiasm ROI and requires streamlines to pass a lateral-posterior thalamic plane (generated with MATLAB) and stop on entry to the chosen LGN ROI, discarding streamlines entering CSF; one or both hemispheres are tracked depending on roiPair. Use it to reconstruct the optic tract given optic chiasm and LGN ROIs in DWI space. Needs DWI, CSD FODs, ROIs and a 5-tissue-type mask of the same subject.

inputs.description: Preprocessed diffusion-weighted image with bvecs and bvals.
Constrained spherical deconvolution FODs (lmax2 to lmax14 files); the FOD at the chosen lmax is what Trekker tracks on.
inputs.requirements: Must contain the FOD file for the requested lmax (or every lmax when single_lmax is false).

inputs.description: Directory of ROI NIfTI files (ROI<name>.nii.gz or <name>.nii.gz) referenced by name in the parameters.
inputs.requirements: ROIs must be in the same space and dimensions as the DWI; otherwise set reslice to true (assumes correct alignment).

inputs.description: 5-tissue-type segmentation in DWI space; its CSF is used to discard streamlines.
Optional whole-brain mask; if absent a mask is computed from the DWI with MRtrix3 dwi2mask.

outputs.description: Tractogram (.tck) of all streamlines generated, merged across ROI pairs and ensemble settings.
Brain mask in DWI space used during tracking (the input mask or one computed with dwi2mask).
White matter classification (classification.mat) assigning streamlines to each tracked pathway, with surface meshes of the ROIs for the brainlife viewer.
Per-run tractograms and tckinfo text files kept as derivatives.

parameters.description: Spherical harmonic order of the FOD to track on (the maximum order when ensembling across lmax).

This field is here for whether or not you want to track both hemispheres or one hemisphere at a time. If just one hemisphere is desired, enter the exact ROI number or name from the rois datatype for the lgn of choice (example: '008109'). If both are desired, enter both separated by a space (example: '008109 008209'). Please see ROI datatype for exact name of each.
this field is the exact ROI name or number from the ROI datatype for the optic chiasm. Example: '085'. Please see ROI datatype for exact name of each.
Number of streamlines (Trekker seed count) to generate per ROI pair and setting.
If true, track only on the FOD of the selected lmax; if false, run ensemble tracking across even lmax values up to lmax.
Trekker probe count; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Trekker probe radius; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Trekker probe quality; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Trekker probe length; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Passed to Trekker useBestAtInit: start each streamline from the best initial direction.
Maximum sampling per seed for Trekker; 'default' lets Trekker choose.
Maximum seed trials for Trekker; 'default' lets Trekker choose.

citations.text: Aydogan D.B., Shi Y. A novel fiber tracking algorithm using parallel transport frames. Proceedings of the 27th Annual Meeting of ISMRM (2019).

failure_modes.cause: No classification.mat was produced, usually because no streamlines were found.
failure_modes.fix: Check the ROI names, exclusions and tracking parameters, and the log.
